Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 21

“Whatever a great person does, others do the same. Whatever standard that one sets, the world follows after it.”

A plain observation about influence. Arjuna's choice is not private; as an exemplar he will be teaching by example whichever way he happens to decide.
